sentences.text: TV Choice is a British weekly TV listings magazine published by H. Bauer Publishing , the UK subsidiary of family-run German company Bauer Media Group .	Bauer	Bauer Verlagsgruppe	TV listings	TV listings (UK)	Bauer Media Group	Bauer Media Group
